mapper.select: SELECT r.chat_room_no /*kr.or.ddit.common.webSocket.chat.mapper.IChatMapper.selectMyRooms*/ ,r.chat_room_nm FROM chat_room r INNER JOIN chat_room_member m ON (r.chat_room_no = m.chat_room_no) WHERE m.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND m.LEFT_DTTM IS NULL

SELECT /*kr.or.ddit.common.webSocket.chat.vo.ChatMessageVO.selectMessages*/ m.CHAT_MSG_NO ,m.CHAT_ROOM_NO ,m.MSG_TY_CD ,m.MSG_CN ,m.ATCH_FILE_ID ,m.REG_DTTM ,m.SENDER_TY ,m.CHAT_MEMBER_ID ,rm.USER_NO AS SENDER_USER_NO FROM CHAT_MESSAGE m JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER rm ON m.CHAT_MEMBER_ID = rm.CHAT_MEMBER_ID WHERE m.CHAT_ROOM_NO = #{chatRoomNo} ORDER BY m.REG_DTTM ASC
